angolo: Gemini Wins Chat, MiMo Leads Coding
descr: Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) beats MiMo-V2.6-Pro in chat votes, while MiMo shines in coding. See scores, hardware fit, and free usage options.
intro: Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) is ahead in blind chat votes, scoring 1497 points versus 1480 for MiMo-V2.6-Pro. The lead is about 52% of the time. MiMo-V2.6-Pro, however, outperforms Gemini in coding tasks.

sezioni.testo: Arena scores come from blind human votes where two anonymous answers are compared. Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) earned 1497 points, 17 points higher than MiMo-V2.6-Pro. With 62,675 votes for Gemini and 4,064 for MiMo, the community prefers Gemini about 52% of the time. The Call line confirms Gemini is ahead.

In the chat category Gemini leads with 1497 points while MiMo scores 1480. Coding tells a different story: MiMo-V2.6-Pro reaches 1624 points, beating Gemini's 1583. Vision favors Gemini again, 1293 to 1247. Each model excels where its architecture shines.

Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) has no public size and does not fit any listed home hardware. It is listed as online-only for RTX 3090, RTX 4090, RTX 5090, RX 7900 XTX, Mac M4 Max 128 GB, and Ryzen AI Max+ 395 128 GB. MiMo-V2.6-Pro is 1 024.2 B (43.9 B active) and requires about 622 GB to download in 4-bit form. It also does not fit the same home hardware, so neither model runs locally on the tested rigs.

Both models are therefore accessed remotely for most users.

Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) can be tried free via the Gemini API free tier, under a proprietary license. It cannot be run locally because weights are not public. MiMo-V2.6-Pro offers open weights, a MIT license, and can be downloaded and run at home, though hardware limits apply.

verdetto: Pick Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) if you prioritize chat quality and vision and are comfortable using a free online API. Pick MiMo-V2.6-Pro if coding performance and open-weight, locally runnable models matter more to you.
